qualification.details: Qualification: A. i) Master's degree with 55% marks (or equivalent grade in a point-scale) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university; A. ii) Cleared NET conducted by UGC or CSIR, or a similar test accredited by UGC like SLET/SET; candidates awarded Ph.D. under UGC Regulations, 2009 or 2016 may be exempted from NET/SLET/SET; Ph.D. registered before July 11, 2009: NET exemption subject to conditions (regular mode, two external examiners, open viva voce, two research papers, two conference papers) certified by Registrar or Dean (Academic Affairs); NET/SLET/SET not required for Masters programmes in disciplines for which NET/SLET/SET is not conducted; OR B. Ph.D. from a foreign university/institution ranked among top 500 in the World University Ranking (any time) by QS, THE or ARWU | Other conditions: | No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs 1500 per lecture, ceiling Rs 50,000 per month

how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application form from the Assam University website (http://www.aus.ac.in/wp-content/uploads/2018/05/Application-form-for-Guest-Faculty.pdf).
Submit the filled form with self attested copies of all supporting documents on the date of the walk-in interview, 20-11-2026.
Attend the walk-in interview at 11.00 AM at the Department of Life Science & Bioinformatics, Assam University, Diphu Campus.

faq.answer: Yes. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

Selection based only on performance in the interview.
